items.title: 'You wanna be gay?' Sydney teens bashed on camera in IS-inspired attacks
items.description: An ABC investigation has obtained distressing videos and victims' accounts of IS sympathisers hunting and bashing gay and bisexual boys on camera in Sydney.

items.title: After four years of war, countries are seeing Russia as a 'spent force'
items.description: For the first time since its invasion, Russia has lost troops faster than it can replace them. It's one of many grim milestones of a bloody war in Ukraine that has now been going for four years.

items.title: Could one surgeon undo decades of advocacy for endometriosis?
items.description: Endometriosis sufferers have been left "sick" and reeling over the findings of a months-long ABC investigation into a Melbourne gynaecologist.

items.title: 'ISIS bride' was 14 when she married a terrorist, sister says
items.description: The sister of an Australian woman who married an Islamic State fighter has revealed how her sister was "groomed" into travelling to a war zone in Syria where she is now stuck.

items.title: What to know about new passport requirements for British dual citizens starting today
items.description: Your guide to the dual citizen entry requirements for the UK that are coming into effect today.

items.title: Prime minister evacuated from The Lodge following security incident
items.description: The incident at Mr Albanese's Canberra residence led to the prime minister being taken to another location for several hours.

items.title: Savannah Guthrie's family offers $1.42m reward to bring home missing mother Nancy
items.description: US TV host Savannah Guthrie has posted a heart-breaking video to Instagram offering a $US1 million ($1.42 million) reward for information leading to the recovery of her missing mother Nancy Guthrie.

items.title: Antisemitism Royal Commission facing 'limitations'
items.description: The Antisemitism Royal Commission is underway but it faces some real tests in delivering justice to those impacted in the wake of the Bondi terror attack.

items.title: 'Our lives have been shattered': Gus's parents release statement
items.description: The parents of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont have released a public statement, saying "every moment without him is unbearable".

items.title: 'Things will be very complicated' without antibiotic, salmon industry warns
items.description: Tasmania's salmon industry is arguing the case to keep using an antibiotic being used to combat bacterial infection in fish stocks, as a possible ban on the drug's usage looms because of it being found in "non-target" species.

items.title: A quarter century has passed but Bradman will 'always be 99.94 not out'
items.description: Sir Donald Bradman was a towering figure in Australian cricket and culture, and some of the game's commentators have paused to reflect on his ongoing significance to the sport 25 years after his death.

items.title: The uneven roads that lead to the Women's Asian Cup — from the intriguing North Korea, to favourite Japan
items.description: The Women's Asian Cup in Australia provides a chance for the Matildas and visiting nations to create history, bring attention to their countries like never before, and seek respect and investment. But each have had varied paths to get here.

items.title: Mayor in Melbourne's west suspended over demeaning Facebook post
items.description: Wyndham City Council mayor Josh Gilligan has been stood down for a month after an investigation found a social media post about a former mayor was belittling and demeaning.

items.title: Ramadan markets an 'antidote to hate' amid anti-Muslim rhetoric
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attended the opening night of the Ramadan night market in Melbourne's Dandenong, which organisers hope will attract at least a million people over the course of the holy month.

items.title: TikTok's algorithm showed Marie self-harm videos. It became too much
items.description: France is set to follow Australia with a social media ban but for these families, who are suing TikTok over what they say is a harmful algorithm, the battle is only beginning.

items.title: Finding a new home brings 'peace' to refugees from war-torn nation
items.description: Churches and families rally around Congolese refugee arrivals in a NSW town known as a welcome zone for those fleeing crisis.

items.title: Travel quiz: Can you win our race around the world?
items.description: Which European city is home to the Rijksmuseum? And which dance style is Argentina best known for?

items.title: 'Brown packages filled with money' being offered in alleged DVA fraud
items.description: A representative for a telehealth company has been caught offering a military advocate a "kickback" for every veteran who signs up to an ongoing medicinal cannabis prescription.

items.title: Broken leg and missed opportunity is driving Anagnostiadis forward
items.description: Armed with a strengthened determination to succeed on the race track, Aiva Anagnostiadis is ready to put her injury woes in the rear-view mirror.

items.title: Obstetrician sentenced to more than 10 years in jail for woman's death in car smash
items.description: A Perth obstetrician who killed a 24-year-old woman after smashing his high performance luxury car into the small hatchback she was a passenger in is sentenced to 10 years and six months in jail.

items.title: SA Labor's stamp duty policy appears at odds with former treasurer's view
items.description: SA Labor has announced a plan to abolish stamp duty for those aged over 60 and planning to downsize at the party's election campaign launch, in what seems to be a major policy shift from the position detailed by the state's former treasurer.

items.title: Sluggish outback storm triggers widespread flood warning
items.description: There are widespread warnings for intense rain and potential flooding, as summer storms hit southern states and an unusually slow-moving system soaks central Australia.

items.title: Lesbian group has no reason to ban trans women, commission says
items.description: Transgender women will have their dignity "undermined" and could be made to feel "inferior" if a lesbian group is allowed to ban them from events, a court has heard.

items.title: Russell Brand pleads not guilty to further rape, sex assault charges
items.description: British actor and comedian Russell Brand pleads not guilty in a London court to two additional charges of rape and sexual assault nearly two decades ago.

items.title: Victorian premier refers allegations against gynaecologist to police
items.description: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has referred allegations against gynaecologist Simon Gordon to police, but the government will not conduct its own investigation.
